Name: Step-In Jab
Effect: Close distance to Mid Range, deal 2 Head DMG, claim Initiative on hit.

Name: Straight Cross
Effect: Fast straight punch in the pocket. +1 DMG if following a Jab.

Name: Overhand Right
Effect: Loops over jabs. 1 Chip DMG on block. Triggers Rocked if unblocked.

Name: Lead Left Hook
Effect: Short arc power shot. Deals 1 Chip DMG + 1 STM drain on block.

Name: Liver Hook
Effect: Permanently reduces opponent Max Stamina Cap by 1 on clean hit.

Name: Rear Uppercut
Effect: Deals +2 bonus DMG if opponent plays a Takedown or Level Change.

Name: Slip & Counter Jab
Effect: Negates Mid Attack, deals 2 DMG, steals Initiative. 0 whiff penalty.

Name: Pull Counter Cross
Effect: Negates Mid Attack, deals 5 Head DMG. Lose 2 STM if baited by Feint.

Name: Check Left Hook
Effect: Negates advancing Attack, deals 3 DMG, pivots out to Long Range.

Name: Shoulder Twitch Feint
Effect: Beats Counter & Defend. Steals Initiative, pushes opponent 1 step to Cage.

Name: Double Jab Feint
Effect: Closes to Mid Range safely. Next Attack in chain gains +1 DMG.

Name: High Guard & Shell
Effect: Blocks Attack (1 Chip vs Heavy), recovers +1 STM. Costs 1 STM at Long.

Name: Inside Calf Kick
Effect: Inflicts -1 Speed penalty on opponent for the rest of the round.

Name: Push Kick (Teep)
Effect: Deals 2 Body DMG and pushes Range 1 step outward (Close->Mid->Long).

Name: Switch Body Kick
Effect: Heavy roundhouse to ribs. Reduces Max Stamina Cap by 1 on hit.

Name: Question Mark Kick
Effect: Bypasses low-guard counters. Deals 5 Head DMG; 1 Chip on block.

Name: Step-In Elbow
Effect: Closes to Close Range. Opens an Eye Cut (reveals 1 opponent card).

Name: Flying Knee
Effect: Jumps 2 zones into Close Range. Massive 6 DMG; -2 STM if blocked.

Name: Shin Check
Effect: Negates Kicks, reflects 2 Leg DMG (-1 SPD). 0 whiff penalty.

Name: Catch & Sweep Kick
Effect: Negates Body/Head Kick, trips opponent for 3 DMG + Initiative.

Name: Knee on Entry
Effect: Negates Takedowns & Step-In Attacks for 5 DMG. -2 STM on whiff.

Name: Low-Kick Fake
Effect: Beats Counter & Defend at Long Range. Steals Initiative + Cage Push.

Name: Thai Plum Clinch
Effect: Bypasses High Guard. Transitions fight to Clinch on Grappling Track.

Name: Long Guard & Frame
Effect: Blocks Attack, recovers +1 STM, and exits 1 Range zone outward.

Name: Blast Double-Leg
Effect: Bypasses High Guard. Moves to Closed Guard (or Side Control if +2 SPD).

Name: Low Single-Leg
Effect: Fast ankle pick. Beats High Guard & Feints; moves to Closed Guard.

Name: Cage Drag Takedown
Effect: Moves to Half Guard. Gains +2 Speed if opponent Cage Space is 0-1.

Name: Harai Goshi Hip Toss
Effect: Throws directly into Side Control and deals 3 Body DMG.

Name: Inside Trip
Effect: Trips from Clinch into Half Guard while keeping Top Initiative.

Name: Mat Return Slam
Effect: Slams escaping opponent back to Closed Guard for 3 Body DMG.

Name: Heavy Sprawl
Effect: Stuffs any Takedown, deals 2 Body DMG, takes Top Initiative.

Name: Whizzer & Overhook
Effect: Reverses Clinch/Takedown attempts and claims Clinch Initiative.

Name: Level-Change Fake
Effect: Baits Sprawls & Uppercuts. Closes distance and steals Initiative.

Name: Granby Roll Escape
Effect: Escapes Closed/Half Guard back to Mid Range Stand-Up.

Name: Knee-Slice Pass
Effect: Advances position 1 step closer to Mount/Back Control.

Name: Toreando Bullfight Pass
Effect: Fast speed pass directly into Side Control if unblocked.

Name: Berimbolo Back Take
Effect: Advanced inversion that transitions directly to Back Control.

Name: Rear-Naked Choke
Effect: Drains 5 STM immediately (full power). Submits target at 0 STM.

Name: Armbar from Guard/Mount
Effect: Drains 4 STM (-2 in Closed Guard unless target <50% STM).

Name: Triangle Choke
Effect: Drains 4 STM (-2 unless target <50% STM). Traps posture on hit.

Name: Mounted Guillotine
Effect: Drains 5 STM (-2 in Clinch unless target <50% STM).

Name: Inside Heel Hook
Effect: Drains 3 STM + deals 4 Leg DMG (-1 SPD). Bypasses Positional Gate.

Name: Scissor Sweep
Effect: Reverses Top Pass/Strike into Top Half Guard + Initiative.

Name: Upa Trap & Roll
Effect: Reverses Mount directly into Top Closed Guard.

Name: Guard Pull
Effect: Safely pulls opponent into your Closed Guard with Bottom Initiative.

Name: Frame & Shrimp Escape
Effect: Recovers from Side Control/Mount back to Closed Guard + 1 STM.

Name: Hammerfist Barrage
Effect: Deals 3 Head DMG from top control; drains 1 STM if blocked.

Name: Crucifix Elbows
Effect: Devastating top elbows. 5 Head DMG + opens Eye Cut.

Name: Cut the Cage
Effect: Closes distance and pushes opponent 2 steps toward the Cage Wall.

Name: Circle Out & Reset
Effect: Escapes 1 Range zone outward and restores +1 Cage Space.

Name: Read Tendencies
Effect: Beats Counter/Defend. Draw 1 card and reveal 1 card in opponent hand.

Name: Deep Breath & Pace
Effect: Recover +3 Stamina. (Costs 1 STM if used at Long Range).

Name: Signature Stance Guard
Effect: Always available outside hand. Blocks Attack (or escapes 1 pos on mat).

Name: Bruised Shin (Curse)
Effect: Unplayable dead card in hand. Spend 1 STM to discard at end of turn.

Name: Concussion Fog (Curse)
Effect: While in hand, your maximum Combo Chain length is reduced by 1.
